The two credit books the Cockpit reads: Saudi corporate (20 quarters) and Saudi retail (20 months).
The Early Warning service's own releases: every exposure scored and banded by the rule set, the owners, the supporting tables and the published series.
SIMAH-style bureau signals, keyed to the books' customers and borrowers.
Open-banking account signals (inflows, buffers, returned payments), keyed to the books' customers and borrowers.
The What-If IFRS 9 domain: every exposure with the PD, LGD, EAD and scenario inputs the engine re-measures ECL from, per period; final ECL reconciles to the books.

Pre-deal credit proposals (existing borrowers keyed to the corporate book, new-to-bank names with their own DN ids), their facility lines, financials, security, the versioned parameter tables, the portfolio headroom the limits are measured against, and the priced results (ask and recommended structu

Retail application and behavioural scorecards and the SME scorecard: every scored account or borrower, its characteristics and bins, score, grade, PD, overrides and the 12-month outcome. Keyed to the books' customers, accounts and borrowers.
The branch (and, for corporate, the business unit and relationship manager) of every book customer, by period, consistent with the customer's region.

The Admin console's configuration: users and their roles, teams, data access policies and their scope, approval workflow steps, AI Studio configurations and the AI run log. Keyed to the Core users (username) and the Branches and RMs domain (RM and branch IDs).

Breaches of the CBUAE Credit Risk Management Standards found on the books: one row per breach (article, facility or account, measured vs required, EAD and ECL) and one row per check and book. Keyed to the corporate (CF…/CB…) and retail (RA…/RC…) book IDs at their latest periods.

A borrower's own figures -- revenue, EBITDA, debt, leverage -- repeat once per facility after this join. Aggregate the facility side first, or de-duplicate on borrower_id, before summing anything from the borrower side.

A facility with three pledged assets appears three times. Summing ead_sar_mn across this join counts the same exposure once per asset. Sum the ALLOCATED collateral value against a de-duplicated facility total.
A facility with four covenant tests appears four times. Untested is not compliant: a facility with no covenant row is absent from an inner join rather than counted as passing.
v4-saudi-retail-20m-v5 · c23a15d78ba88d39
retail_customer_month already carries total_ead_sar_mn and total_ecl_sar_mn summed across that customer's accounts. Joining and summing them again counts each customer once per account held.
One row each way, so this join repeats nothing. It is stated because the two relations share account_id and reporting_month and joining on account_id alone would cross every month with every other.
An inner join here silently drops every unsecured account, so a portfolio total computed across it is a secured-only total. Use a left join, or say that the figure is secured lending.
